implementation_note: Third implementation slice of the milestone-integrated SDK plan; delivered inside the existing document owner, not as a separate SDK phase.
app_features: om9-app --no-default-features (standalone Controller/document/scene/archive; no OCCT adapter, no FreeCAD/Rhino host)
asserted_semantics: layers() reports name, colour and effective visible/selectable/locked flags for the captured document plus the command's own created/updated records, and marks the current layer including a staged selection.

layer_create validates the document name grammar and budget in the host; name uniqueness, preset-slot and layer budget admission stay with LayerPlan::admit. make_current creates and selects the layer in one plan.
layer_update renames, recolours or changes flags of one layer and requires an editable (unlocked) layer; a layer created by the same command can be updated.
set_current_layer selects or clears the current layer; selecting a layer created by the same command folds into its creation plan.

assign_objects_to_layer accepts an existing or this-command-created layer, requires the source layer to be editable, clears the object colour so the layer colour applies, and assigns already-staged additions directly.

One layer write per layer per command. Adding objects to a layer whose flags change in the same command, or assigning objects off such a source layer, is refused with layer before the transaction permission-read rule.
A layer created by the command cannot receive newly added objects until the next command (insert admission validates the captured world).
Assignment is an attribute write, so it conflicts with a transform, attribute edit or rename of the same object.
